full_judgment: 2. Case of the plaintiffs as set out in their plaint is that plaintiffs Nos. 8.18 along with proforma defendants Nos. 2.5 were proprietors of revenue paying estate comprised in touzi No. 7414 of Faridpur Collectorate. This touzi has been recorded in R. S. Khatian No. 509 of mouza Bhennabari. There are three under tenures of this touzi and they have been recorded in R.S, Khatians Nos. 510, 512 and 514 of the same mouza Plaintiffs No. 7-18 also held the under tenure recorded in one of them, namely R.S. Khatian No. 510 directly under the estate and their names have been recorded as under tenure holders therein. Plaintiffs Nos. 1-6 were not owners of the estate but they have possessed the under-tenure interests in the other two under-tenures recorded in Khatians Nos. 512 and 514 under the plaintiffs Nos. 8 to 18. These plaintiffs claimed to have been in actual possession of the land and some of them have got their homestead therein. On 13.7.59 they came to learn that the touzi was sold to one Kali Krishna Chakraborty in auction for arrears of government revenue on 22.6 55. No notice of the sale had been served upon them but a notice was found to have been issued to one dead proprietor namely, Bicharan Biswas, predecessor in interests of plain tiffs Nos. 10, 11 and 12. The sale was therefore invalid and the under tenures were never annulled. On the wholesale acquisition of rent receiving interest from April, 156 the plaintiffs were recorded in the S. A. Khatians as tenants-in-possession under the government, But defdt. No. 1, Ammullaya Ch. Kundu claiming that the auction purchaser Kali Krishna Chakraborty had been his benamdars filed an objection petition under section 19 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 to the Revenue Officer, Gopalganj and got his name recorder as tenant in possession under an order dated 13.7.59. This order of the Revenue Officer got no basis whatever and the plaintiffs title to the land was not affected thereby. Hence they filed the suit praying that title of plaintiffs NO.9 be declared in 'K' schedule land representing R.S. Khatian No. 512, that of plaintiffs, Nos. 1-5 in 'Kha' schedule land representing R.S. Khatian No. 514 and that of plaintiff Nos. 7.18 in ‘Ga’ schedule land representing R. S. Khatian No. 510.
